# setup
## libraries
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)
library(zoo)
library(data.table)

# ── project functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
source('./functions/params.R')
source('./functions/theme.R')
source('./functions/general.R')
source('./functions/r_general.R')
source('./functions/glm_generic.R')

```
 
## directories
```{r}
dir_sessions          <- './data/sessions/'
dir_null              <- './data/glm_null_distributions/'
dir_output_combined   <- './data/sessions_combined_subject/'

dir.create(dir_null,            recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dir_output_combined, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## logs / keys
```{r}
# ── analysis inclusion / exclusion log (local xlsx) ──────────────────────────
log_analysis_subjects <- read_xlsx('./logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'subjects',    na = c('NA', ''))
log_analysis_fp       <- read_xlsx('./logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'fp',          na = c('NA', ''))

log_placements <- read.csv('./logs_and_keys/log_fiber_placements.csv', na.strings = c('', 'NA'))
```

---

# session filter
```{r}
# ── sessions included in glm analysis (wrsuc, frsuc, wrnacl only) ─────────────
glm_set_ids <- c('wrnacl')

log_data <- log_analysis_fp %>%
  filter(is.na(exclude) | exclude != 1) %>%
  get_set_id() %>%
  filter(set_id %in% glm_set_ids)

# ── read per-session signal quality metrics ────────────────────────────────────
fns_qc_metrics      <- list.files(dir_sessions, pattern = 'quality_metrics.csv', recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
combined_qc_metrics <- bind_rows(lapply(fns_qc_metrics, read.csv))
```

```{r}
# ── blockname × region inclusion key ─────────────────────────────────────────
# one row per session × region; used to filter signal files passed to python glm

blockname_region_filtered <- log_data %>%
  select(subject, blockname, set_id) %>%
  left_join(combined_qc_metrics %>% select(blockname, region), by = 'blockname')

# retain da regions only
blockname_region_filtered <- blockname_region_filtered %>%
  filter(!str_detect(region, 'lha')) %>%
  arrange(blockname, region)

# remove histologically misplaced fibers; keep region_original for file matching
blockname_region_filtered <- blockname_region_filtered %>%
  mutate(region_original = region) %>%       # raw ID saved before label conversion
  format_regions('region', key_regions) %>%  # standardise region label strings
  filter_placements('exclude_da_consumption') %>%
  select(-starts_with('hit'))

# ── python-ready key: additionally filter by signal quality ───────────────────
blockname_region_filtered_python <- blockname_region_filtered %>%
  filter_qc_metrics(combined_qc_metrics, removal_type = 1)

blockname_region_filtered_python %>%
  write_csv('./data/key_blockname_region_filtered.csv')
```

---

# execution
## step 1: generate per-session glm matrices

```{r}
# ── optional: restrict to specific blocknames ─────────────────────────────────
# set to NA to process all sessions (default); override to reprocess specific sessions:
#   target_blocknames <- c('2026_01_30_acr09')
target_blocknames <- NA

fns <- blockname_region_filtered$blockname %>% unique()

if (!anyNA(target_blocknames)) {
  fns <- target_blocknames
  cat('targeting', length(fns), 'blockname(s):', paste(fns, collapse = ', '), '\n')
}
```

```{r}
# ── glm parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_samples_per_trial <- 180   # samples per trial at 20 Hz × 9 s window (-3 to 6 s)
```

```{r}
# ── generate per-session prediction and signal matrices ───────────────────────
# set toggle_process = 1 to run; = 0 to skip (matrices already exist)
toggle_process         <- 1
toggle_generate_nulls  <- 1   # generate null distributions for python glm (slow)

if (toggle_process) {

  set.seed(42)   # set here so generation is reproducible on every run of this chunk

  # prediction matrix: trial timing and solution identity
  batch_get_prediction_matrix_multispout(fns)

  # finalise predictors: write per-session predictor csv files to glm/ subfolder
  finalize_prediction_matrix_multispout_batch(fns, dir_sessions)

  # signal matrix: per-region z-scored peth signal
  generate_signal_matrix_batch(dir_sessions, fns)

  # diagonal predictor: true trial solution identity (scaled concentration)
  batch_get_trial_diagonal_matricies(
    dir_sessions          = dir_sessions,
    fns                   = fns,
    n_samples_per_trial   = n_samples_per_trial,
    toggle_solution_shuffle = 0
  )

  # diagonal predictor: shuffled trial solution identity (null control)
  batch_get_trial_diagonal_matricies(
    dir_sessions          = dir_sessions,
    fns                   = fns,
    n_samples_per_trial   = n_samples_per_trial,
    toggle_solution_shuffle = 1
  )

  # null distributions for python glm (optional — slow)
  if (toggle_generate_nulls) {
    generate_nulls_v02(blockname_region_filtered_python, dir_sessions, dir_null,
                       region_ids = blockname_region_filtered_python$region_original %>% unique())
    pad_signal_matrix(dir_null, n_cols = 100)
  }


}
```

---

## step 2: combine per-subject matrices
```{r}
# ── sessions to combine: last 4 sessions per subject × set_id ─────────────────
log_data_combined_subject <- blockname_region_filtered %>%
  left_join(log_data %>% select(blockname, last04), by = 'blockname') %>%
  filter(last04 == 1) %>%
  arrange(subject, set_id, region)

combined_sets <- log_data_combined_subject %>%
  select(subject, set_id) %>%
  unique()
```

```{r}
# ── combine signals and predictors across sessions for each subject × set_id ──
# output structure per subject × set_id:
#   sessions_combined_subject/<subject>_<set_id>/signals/    — stacked signal csvs
#   sessions_combined_subject/<subject>_<set_id>/predictors/ — stacked predictor csvs
#   sessions_combined_subject/<subject>_<set_id>/sample_info.csv — row-level metadata

overwrite <- 1

for (combined_set_n in seq(1, nrow(combined_sets))) {

  combined_set <- combined_sets[combined_set_n, ] %>%
    left_join(log_data_combined_subject, by = join_by(subject, set_id))

  stem_set              <- str_c(combined_set$subject[1], '_', combined_set$set_id[1])
  dir_stem_set          <- str_c(dir_output_combined, stem_set, '/')
  dir_stem_set_signals  <- str_c(dir_stem_set, 'signals/')
  dir_stem_set_pred     <- str_c(dir_stem_set, 'predictors/')

  print(str_c(' - ', stem_set, ' [', combined_set_n, ' / ', nrow(combined_sets), ']'))

  # skip or recreate output folder based on overwrite flag
  if (dir.exists(dir_stem_set)) {
    if (overwrite == 0) {
      print('  * already combined — skipped (set overwrite = 1 to recreate)')
      next
    } else {
      unlink(dir_stem_set, recursive = TRUE)
    }
  }

  dir.create(dir_stem_set)
  dir.create(dir_stem_set_signals)
  dir.create(dir_stem_set_pred)

  blockname_strs <- combined_set$blockname %>% unique()

  for (blockname_str in blockname_strs) {

    fn_signals    <- list.files(str_c(dir_sessions, blockname_str, '/glm/signals/'))
    fn_predictors <- list.files(str_c(dir_sessions, blockname_str, '/glm/'), pattern = '.csv')

    # keep only zscoreblsub signal files
    fn_signals <- fn_signals[grepl('zscoreblsub\\.csv$', fn_signals)]

    # keep only signal files for regions present in log_data_combined_subject
    # (filter_placements already removed bad placements at the row level)
    valid_regions <- log_data_combined_subject %>%
      filter(blockname == blockname_str) %>%
      pull(region_original)

    fn_signals_df <- tibble(blockname = blockname_str, fn = fn_signals) %>%
      mutate(region = str_remove_all(fn, '_zscoreblsub\\.csv')) %>%
      filter(region %in% valid_regions)

    fn_signals <- fn_signals_df$fn

    # append signal files
    for (fn_signal in fn_signals) {
      df <- read.csv(str_c(dir_sessions, blockname_str, '/glm/signals/', fn_signal), header = FALSE)
      fn <- str_c(dir_stem_set_signals, fn_signal)
      if (blockname_str == blockname_strs[1] && file.exists(fn)) file.remove(fn)
      if (!file.exists(fn)) {
        write_csv(df, fn, col_names = FALSE)
      } else {
        write.table(df, file = fn, sep = ',', col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE)
      }
    }

    nrow_sig <- nrow(df)

    # append predictor files
    for (fn_predictor in fn_predictors) {
      df <- read.csv(str_c(dir_sessions, blockname_str, '/glm/', fn_predictor), header = FALSE)
      fn <- str_c(dir_stem_set_pred, fn_predictor)
      if (blockname_str == blockname_strs[1] && file.exists(fn)) file.remove(fn)
      if (!file.exists(fn)) {
        write_csv(df, fn, col_names = FALSE)
      } else {
        write.table(df, file = fn, sep = ',', col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE)
      }
    }

    nrow_pred <- nrow(df)

    # build and append sample_info: row-level trial metadata aligned to signal rows
    sample_info <- read.csv(str_c(dir_sessions, blockname_str, '/', blockname_str, '_data_prediction_matrix_full.csv')) %>%
      select(blockname, trial_num, tm_bin) %>%
      left_join(
        read.csv(str_c(dir_sessions, blockname_str, '/', blockname_str, '_data_trial_summary.csv')) %>%
          select(blockname, trial_num, trial_start_ts, spout, solution, trial_lick, lick_count),
        by = join_by(blockname, trial_num)
      )

    fn <- str_c(dir_stem_set, 'sample_info.csv')
    if (!file.exists(fn)) {
      write_csv(sample_info, fn)
    } else {
      write.table(sample_info, file = fn, sep = ',', col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE)
    }

    nrow_info <- nrow(sample_info)

    print(str_c('  ~ ', blockname_str, '  sig/pred/info rows: ', nrow_sig, ' / ', nrow_pred, ' / ', nrow_info))
  }
}
```
